one_line: Eastern Ganga king Narasimhadeva I with his master temple architects during the building of the Konark Sun Temple on the Chandrabhaga coast.

appearance.age_look: mid-40s royal warrior king flanked by two craftsmen in their 30s, all lean and strong
appearance.face: Narasimhadeva I has an oval, sharp-featured face with medium-brown coastal complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed moustache, calm intense eyes and a composed, authoritative expression; the sthapatis have slightly softer features, similar complexion, focused and thoughtful gazes.
appearance.hair: Narasimhadeva I’s black hair is medium-length and smoothed back into a low knot partially covered by a simple golden circlet with a small central sun emblem; the leading sthapati’s black hair is tied in a high topknot with a narrow white cloth band, while the junior sthapati’s hair is shorter, combed back and tied in a small knot at the nape.
appearance.costume: Narasimhadeva I wears a formal Kalinga royal ensemble: a rich deep-red silk dhoti with thin gold borders, pleated to mid-calf and tied in a broad knot at the front, a fitted short-sleeved golden-yellow silk angarkha-style upper garment reaching just below the waist and fastened at the right side, and a dark green cotton-silk uttariya draped from his left shoulder across the torso and over the left arm; his feet are in simple brown leather sandals. He is adorned with a modest but regal set of jewellery—medium-thick gold neck torc, two layered bead necklaces, gold kadas on both wrists, and small sun-shaped gold earrings. The leading sthapati wears an unbleached off-white cotton dhoti wrapped securely with a slightly longer length reaching to the ankles, a light grey cotton short-sleeve tunic ending at the hips, and a soft faded-blue cotton shawl across his right shoulder and around the waist; he has simple wooden sandals, a thin copper necklace, and a palm-leaf measuring cord tied at his belt. The junior sthapati wears a plain off-white dhoti to the ankles, a pale ochre cotton sleeveless vest, and a light brown cotton scarf looped at the neck and over one shoulder, barefoot for site work, with only a thin black thread necklace and no metal jewellery.
appearance.signature: Narasimhadeva I holds a sheathed straight-edged royal sword with a simple bronze hilt and a deep-brown scabbard, while the leading sthapati carries a long bamboo measuring rod marked with proportional divisions and a rolled palm-leaf plan tucked at his waist.

ref_desc: Narasimhadeva I has an oval medium-brown face, low-knotted black hair under a sun-emblem gold circlet, deep-red dhoti, golden-yellow angarkha, dark green uttariya and sheathed bronze-hilt sword, flanked by two off-white-dhoti sthapatis with blue and ochre shawls and bamboo measuring rod.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character group model of Narasimhadeva I with his two Konark sthapatis on the 13th-century Chandrabhaga coast: the king is mid-40s, lean and dignified, with an oval medium-brown face, straight nose, neatly trimmed moustache and calm intense eyes, his black hair pulled into a low knot partly covered by a simple golden circlet bearing a small sun emblem. He wears a deep-red silk dhoti with thin gold borders pleated to mid-calf, a fitted golden-yellow short-sleeved angarkha-style upper garment, and a dark green uttariya draped from his left shoulder over his torso and arm, with brown leather sandals and modest royal jewellery—a gold neck torc, layered bead necklaces, gold wrist kadas and sun-shaped earrings—while he holds by his side a sheathed straight royal sword with a bronze hilt and deep-brown scabbard. Beside him stand two craftsmen: the leading sthapati in an off-white cotton dhoti to the ankles, light grey short-sleeved tunic, faded-blue shawl over his shoulder and waist, high topknot bound with a white cloth band, simple wooden sandals, thin copper necklace, carrying a long bamboo measuring rod and a rolled palm-leaf plan at his belt; and the junior sthapati in a plain off-white dhoti, pale ochre sleeveless vest, light brown scarf at neck and over one shoulder, small low knot of hair, barefoot, with a thin black thread necklace. Show them front-facing in neutral, consistent lighting, with clear view of their faces, hairstyles, layered garments, sandals or bare feet, sword, measuring rod and palm-leaf plans, using deep red, golden yellow, dark green, off-white and faded blue as dominant colors.
